items.q: Mary told me, said, 'Yes, Phil, he did not want that horn at all.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Mary told me, said, 'Yes, Phil, he did not want that horn at all.' He started to go to medical. He wanted to be a doctor. So that's what he is. That ain't bad company -- a doctor! That's where all the money is now. Because look at me. I went to the doctor yesterday, it cost me almost a hundred dollars. You know what I mean?
